fact: The Ministry of Health's statistical yearbook for 2021, produced by its own Sistema de Informação da Saúde (SIS) office, states that the Ministry chose DHIS2 as the management software of the health information system, to produce periodic reports and health bulletins and to serve as the data warehouse fed from source systems, with a web portal for sharing data; no date is given for the choice, so the document's published date is used.

The Ministry of Health's own page for the Sistema de Informação da Saúde states that DHIS2 was officially launched as the health information system on 18 December 2019 in the presence of the Minister of Health, describes it as a web platform for digital forms and indicators, national-level data storage, report generation and aggregate data, and names a SIS coordinator.
